headline: Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas, Trilegal act on Ather Energy ₹1,300 crore QIP
sum: Ather Energy Limited has raised ₹1,300 crore from a Qualified Institutional Placement of the equity shares comprised of allotment of 1,08,15,307 equity shares. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised Ather Energy on this QIP.
detail: Ather Energy Limited has raised ₹1,300 crore from a Qualified Institutional Placement of the equity shares comprised of allotment of 1,08,15,307 equity shares. Shardul Amarchand Mangaldas & Co advised Ather Energy on this QIP. The transaction team consisted of Prashant Gupta (National Practice Head – Capital Markets), Ruth Chenchiah (Partner), Rishika Sharma (Senior Associate) and Aditya Krishnan (Associate). Prashant Gupta, Ruth Chenchiah Trilegal advised the lead managers, namely, HSBC Securities and Capital Markets (India) Limited, Axis Capital Limited, Nomura Financial Advisory and Securities (India) Private, BofA Securities India Limited, Goldman Sachs (India) Securities Private…
